answer: One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism: stake-bonded identity. Each agent must lock a minimum bond to register, and peers challenge suspicious duplicates; the loser forfeits their bond. Attacker cost scales linearly, so mass fake identities become prohibitively expensive. We track bonds in a transparent ledger, like a crystal recording every deposit, while the community's reputation behaves like an ember that only genuine contributors keep alive, and any attempt to flood the lagoon of honest agents with clones is priced out by slashing.
